summary: An applicant arrives at the hearing with the changes town staff asked for already drawn in.
realLife: Before the Arlington Heights hearings the housing group consulted village staff about fire and building requirements and incorporated every change staff recommended.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with applicant, plan, revision. A commissioner can ask which objections remain after staff review.

turns.what: Staff catch an exit blocked by the last revision.
turns.pulledBy: The architect moved a wall after the fire review.
turns.writesBack: The applicant withdraws that sheet for correction.
